name: No Labeling / No Design
short_description: Clean enclosure without any labels or designs
long_description: A clean, unmarked enclosure surface. Perfect if you want to add your own labeling later or prefer a minimalist look.

name: Labeled Lettering
long_description: Basic text labeling for knobs, switches, and jacks. We'll add clear, professional lettering to identify all controls on your pedal. Please specify your desired labels in the order notes.

name: Simple Waterslide Decal Lettering
short_description: Keeep it simple with waterslide decal text
long_description: Waterslide decal lettering for a clean, professional look. Ideal for simple text labels without complex graphics. Please provide desired text and font style in order notes.

name: Customized Waterslide Decal Graphic
long_description: Full custom waterslide decal with your own graphic design. You can provide artwork files (vector preferred) or describe your vision. Includes logo, text, and decorative elements as specified.

name: Engraving
long_description: Amateurish hand engraving of text labels directly into the enclosure surface. Provides a unique, tactile labeling solution with a vintage vibe. Can also be filled with black paint or fake rust for better visibility. Please specify desired text in order notes.

name: Relic
long_description: Professional aging treatment to give your pedal a vintage, road-worn look. Includes intentional scratches, wear patterns, and patina effects. Each relic job is unique. Note: This finish cannot be combined with pristine powder coating or certain metallic finishes. Manual review may be required.
